comments.body: Caught it? I found this plant on the ground. It had fallen out of the tree because the twig it was on had broken. I kept it because the overall shape was really nice. It was loaded with flowers every day. The flowers don't last all day, but next day there are a bunch more. They're just really small, so most people haven't even noticed they exist. :)
I meant you caught it in flower;  I've picked up a lot of those, looking for the elusive blue/purple flower.
Look in the mornings. I think the flowers close by afternoon or at least are not in the best shape then.
Well you got such a good shot;  glad you posted it and I'll keep looking!
